_comment: Pre-registered seeded-defect roster for the verifier-calibration probe. Frozen BEFORE any verifier is dispatched (see plan risk: loosening a signature after seeing a tier's result would make catch/miss post-hoc rather than mechanical). Each defect is seeded onto a throwaway probe/<defect_id> branch cut from an EXISTING tools-resume-builder host_branch; the branch is verified at HIGH and MID and then deleted. 4 classes x 2 defects. 6 grounded in real telemetry blocking-fail rounds; 2 (data-loss-path) explicitly synthetic — no real blocking-fail round of that class exists in telemetry.

defects.description: Introduces a TypeScript type error (a string-typed const assigned a number) into the example-gallery data module, so `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) no longer compiles. Reproduces the risk class flagged at issue-8 plan round 1: 'Full gate green (format:check + build specifically) has no unit done_criteria asserting it' — a defect only caught by actually running the build, not by reading unit criteria.
defects.violated_criterion: Full gate green: format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build. (issue-8 entry contract AC#10)

signature.criterion: Full gate green: format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build

defects.description: Disables the confirm dialog's focus trap: the keydown handler now early-returns on Tab before the cyclic-focus logic runs, so the browser's default Tab handling moves focus out of the open dialog. This violates the accessible-dialog focus-trap containment criterion and breaks the app.test.tsx focus-trap (Tab/Shift+Tab wrap) test. Reproduces the exact gap flagged at issue-2 plan round 1: 'no test specified for focus-trap containment (Tab/Shift+Tab wrap) while dialog open'.
defects.grounding: 2026-07-25T020910Z__tools-resume-builder__plan__issue-2__eaec69.events.jsonl round1 (blocking-fail, score 0.62): 'no test specified for focus-trap containment (Tab/Shift+Tab wrap) while dialog open'.
defects.violated_criterion: Keyboard accessible: Escape closes the dialog without clearing, focus is trapped inside the dialog while open, and focus returns to the Clear button on close. (issue-2 entry contract AC#5; test AC#7 covers focus-trap containment Tab/Shift+Tab wrap)

signature.criterion: focus is trapped inside the dialog while open

defects.description: Removes the auto-dismiss timer from useToast.show(): the toast is opened but no setTimeout is scheduled, so it never auto-dismisses. This makes the documented behavior 'auto-dismisses after a few seconds via a real timer' false in the shipped app and breaks the app's real-timer auto-dismiss test. This is the failing-contract analogue of the issue-13 intake claims_audit class: a documented behavior claim made false by the code.
defects.grounding: 2026-07-26T175636Z__tools-resume-builder__intake__issue-13__4ae521.events.jsonl round1 (blocking-fail, score 0.85): claims_audit factual error on vitest fake-timer usage (documented-behavior-claim-made-false class); the auto-dismiss behavior here is the toast branch's real AC#3 timer contract.
defects.violated_criterion: The toast auto-dismisses after a few seconds via a real timer. (issue-13 entry contract AC#3; TDD AC#8 verifies auto-dismiss with the real-timer waitFor pattern)

signature.criterion: auto-dismisses after a few seconds via a real timer

defects.description: Breaks the unsaved-changes dirty-check in handleSelectVersion so `lossless` is always true: switching versions therefore never opens the ConfirmDialog and silently discards unsaved edits in the current draft. SYNTHETIC — no real blocking-fail round of the data-loss class exists in telemetry; this is a constructed data-loss defect against the version-switcher's real AC#3 unsaved-changes guard.
defects.violated_criterion: If the current draft has unsaved changes that would be lost by switching, the user is warned via the existing ConfirmDialog pattern before the switch proceeds; canceling leaves the draft and active version unchanged. (issue-5 entry contract AC#3)

signature.criterion: the user is warned via the existing ConfirmDialog pattern before the switch proceeds

defects.description: Bypasses the overwrite-confirmation guard in handleExampleSelected: selecting a gallery example now always calls applyExample immediately instead of routing a non-empty draft through the pendingExample confirm dialog, so choosing an example silently overwrites unsaved resume content. SYNTHETIC — no real blocking-fail round of the data-loss class exists in telemetry; constructed against the example-gallery's real AC#4 overwrite-confirmation guard. (Adapted from the plan's illustrative JSON/ZIP-import wording to the actual confirm-before-overwrite mechanism present in the code.)
defects.violated_criterion: The overwrite-confirmation guard fires before replacing a non-empty resume, reusing #7's shipped isResumeContentEmpty() check and the existing ConfirmDialog component ... and is skippable (Cancel) / cancelable (Escape/backdrop). (issue-8 entry contract AC#4)

signature.criterion: The overwrite-confirmation guard fires before replacing a non-empty resume

defects.description: Reverts the toast's floating-overlay positioning: the cva base classes drop `fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50` so the toast renders inline in normal document flow rather than as an elevated floating overlay. Tests still pass (they assert text/role/aria-live, not CSS positioning), so the app is silently wrong. Reproduces the issue-13 plan round 1 finding that no done-criterion enforced the toast being a floating overlay distinct from document flow.
defects.grounding: 2026-07-26T180953Z__tools-resume-builder__plan__issue-13__81310b.events.jsonl round1 (blocking-fail, score 0.79): 'No unit done-criteria enforce the toast is visually positioned as a floating overlay (fixed/absolute, distinct from document flow) ... an implementer could ship a recolored inline element in the old status paragraph's flow position and pass every done-criterion'.
defects.violated_criterion: The toast is visually positioned as a floating overlay (fixed/absolute positioning + elevated z-index ...) distinct from normal document flow — not an inline element occupying the old status paragraph's flow position. (issue-13 entry contract AC#2)

signature.criterion: visually positioned as a floating overlay

defects.description: Poisons the content-based variant classifier: the two real failure-path error strings ('That file doesn't look like a resume export.' from handleJsonImport's parse-failure branch, and 'Could not read that ZIP file.' from handleZipImport's non-Error fallback) are added to the SUCCESS_MESSAGES set, so classifyVariant() misclassifies both as success and neither real failure path ever renders as an error-styled toast in the shipped app. Reproduces the issue-13 plan round 2 finding ('the two real failure paths ... would never actually render as error-styled toasts ... the error variant would be dead code') via the actual fail-closed classifier mechanism, not an invented signature change.
defects.grounding: 2026-07-26T180953Z__tools-resume-builder__plan__issue-13__81310b.events.jsonl round2 (blocking-fail, score 0.78): 'the two real failure paths (App.tsx ~103 ZIP-import failure, ~118 JSON-import parse failure) would never actually render as error-styled toasts in the shipped app — the error variant would be dead code only exercised by isolated unit tests'.
defects.violated_criterion: Variant (success/error) is conveyed from App.tsx's real call sites to the toast via a content-based classifier ... at least one real success path and one real failure path are covered end-to-end by tests proving both variants are reachable in the shipped app. (issue-13 entry contract AC#13; AC#3 end-to-end variant reachability)

signature.criterion: conveyed from App.tsx's real call sites to the toast via a content-based classifier
